run_evaluation_from_pkl: run evaluation on a trained HMR model by loading reconstruction error data from pickle files across iterations
run_evaluation_cli: run the eval script with a checkpoint path and dataset name via command-line arguments
analyze_recon_error_per_iter: analyze per-iteration reconstruction error and keypoint error from pickle files and print mean values
find_best_iteration: find the best iteration with minimum reconstruction error across all samples in the dataset
threshold_by_keypoint_error: select the earliest iteration per sample where 2D keypoint error falls below a threshold
